Scenario fixture: form-control-single-label (at most one <label> per control)

Each target control has a stable id of the form fcsl_case_NN.

A. Valid

01 — PASS: single wrapping label
02 — PASS: single label[for]
03 — PASS: label wraps AND self-references via for (counts once, not two)

B. Invalid

04 — FAIL: two label[for] point at the same control
05 — FAIL: wrapping label plus a separate label[for] targeting the same control

C. Not applicable (skipped, not counted)

06 — NEUTRAL: control with no label at all (covered by a different rule)
07 — PASS: one visible label[for] plus a display:none decoy label[for] (only one AT-eligible label)

End of fixture.
